items.title: discoDSP releases WavePrompt, a FREE AI music generation app for macOS and Windows
items.excerpt: From developer discoDSP comes WavePrompt, a free AI music generation app for macOS and Windows that brings the text-to-music approach to a standalone desktop tool for producers.

items.title: YouTube sticks new labels on AI-generated songs
YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
items.excerpt: The label will appear on the player page and include songs entirely generated by AI or partially, such as AI involved in composition and vocals.

items.title: YouTube Music adds new labels for AI-generated content
items.excerpt: Now please let us hide all of it.

items.title: YouTube Music starts labeling AI-generated songs, using partner disclosures and its own detection tools
items.excerpt: 'Our listeners have told us they want transparency when they're hearing an AI-generated track,' said YouTube. Labels draw on partner disclosures plus YouTube's own detection tools.

items.title: Deezer will let listeners completely filter out AI music
Deezer will soon let you filter out AI-generated music
items.excerpt: Deezer said that the new toggle will be rolled out by the end of the year.

items.title: Deezer lets users hide AI music; Playhead generates signal chains for producers
items.excerpt: Playhead is music production software that works in all DAWs and creates bespoke signal processing chains from producers' plain-language descriptions of the sound they want; plus Deezer's option to hide 100% AI-generated music.

items.title: Today in Music AI news: Raye gets botted; UMG senior AI role; Character•AI bankruptcy; Rocketship launches
items.excerpt: Rocketship launches an AI platform that analyses 80+ audio, lyric and contextual parameters to profile a song's potential audience before release; UMG appoints ex-Spotify AI DJ lead Oscar Celma as SVP applied AI.

items.title: Audiotool reveals six winners from its ‘Let’s Build!’ hackathon
items.excerpt: Audiotool's 'Let's Build!' hackathon winners include Pocket Producer, an AI agent for music producers, and an AI A&R Assistant that analyses tracks and estimates earning potential.

items.title: Sen. Marsha Blackburn Slammed for ‘Cringe’ AI Video of Her as Kendrick Lamar Performing ‘Not Like Us’ at Super Bowl
items.excerpt: U.S. Sen. Marsha Blackburn was slammed on social media for posting an AI video of herself performing Kendrick Lamar's "Not Like Us" at the Super Bowl.

items.title: Taylor Swift expands voice trademark filings to the UK, EU, and Australia amid AI deepfake crackdown
items.excerpt: Taylor Swift has extended filings to trademark her voice to the UK, EU and Australia, following three applications submitted to the USPTO in April, as artists seek tools against AI voice deepfakes.

items.title: Raye says ticket scalpers used AI bots to create 'hundreds of thousands of fake registrations' as 1.8M sign up for 5,000 Royal Albert Hall seats
items.excerpt: Presale registration for the Royal Albert Hall show, run through fan marketing platform co:brand, was flooded by AI-bot sign-ups; her team is now manually reviewing registrations.
